results: The actual original periodic unbounded expression is CONSTRUCTED as a bounded complex linear endomorphism of its ENTIRE physical spectral range, using an actual original H1 lift. The lift represents EXACTLY the original physical vector and the physical operator base inclusion equals EXACTLY the original unbounded expression. No projected-expression error or supplied L2 action is used.

Every eigenvalue of the ACTUAL physical spectral restriction is a genuine original full-domain spectral value INSIDE the source circle. Every enclosed genuine original eigenvalue occurs in the restriction. Thus restriction adds NO artificial eigenvalues, while preserving associated-vector directions.

A reusable purely algebraic TWO-dimensional proof gives the upper-triangular residual for EVERY basis starting with a lambda-plus eigenvector when the actual enclosed spectral values are lambda-plus and lambda-minus. The proof handles DISTINCT and COINCIDENT roots, including nonsemisimple operators; no diagonalizability or Jordan basis is assumed.

On ANY actual source-normalized orthonormal spectral basis with original H1 representatives f and phi and first vector the lambda-plus eigenfunction, the ACTUAL native equation is PROVED: (L-lambda-plus)phi=-(lambda-plus-lambda-minus)*phi+eta*f. The equality is in the FULL original H-minus-one base and represents the SAME original unbounded physical action.

The source Lemma 2.13 eta/gamma IDENTITY is PROVED at the CANONICAL ORIGINAL lambda_n^+ and lambda_n^- labels with ONE cutoff BEFORE EVERY original COMPLEX endpoint potential in a specified EXACT original norm ball and ALL subsequent ORIGINAL positive indices. Actual eigenfunction normalization, both source L2 norms ONE and the entire physical orthonormal spectral basis are retained. Source-circle validity, rank TWO, canonical labels, normalized vectors and the residual identity are all PROVED in this uniform source theorem.

EVERY vector in the ENTIRE actual physical spectral range has a representative in the original improved endpoint space FourierLebesgueSpace(2,-r+2,infinity), with IDENTICAL full distribution. This includes sums of distinct algebraic root spaces and all associated vectors. EVERY original H1 representative of such a physical vector is that SAME improved distribution, so neither basis direction needs an additional regularity premise.

Use the already PROVED actual periodic and Dirichlet source-projection convergence, their exact literal free kernels and normalized source eigenfunctions to prove overlap (32) and full source 2.15. The precise Dirichlet C.4(ii) RATE remains OPEN; periodic C.4(i) is complete.
